notes.title: Duel on Board is finally out on Steam
notes.content:
Hello, everyone, we are so happy to announce that after a really long long long time of development, Duel on Board is finally out on Steam today.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/612040/Duel_on_Board/

Duel on Board is a 1 vs 1 local multiplayer competitive / party game where pirates fight for the precious beer while sailing the dangerous high seas. Just like old-school games, you can play with your friend on the same keyboard (or use Joy-cons if you play it on Nintendo Switch)!
 
The Team:
[list]
[*] Developer: rebel rabbit
[*] Publisher: indienova
[/list]

Key Facts:
[list]
[*] Platform: Steam, Nintendo Switch
[*] Release Date: March 4th, 2021
[*] Genre: Party
[*] Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TURaK200noQ
[/list]

Hope you can enjoy it! If you have any ideas to help make it better we would certainly like to hear them. Welcome to join in our discord: https://discord.gg/rebelrabbit

notes.title: Duel on Board - Demo available
notes.content:
Hey guys and girls!

Our game Duel on Board is almost done! We are just polishing some details and fixing some tiny bugs <3

While we are on it, you can give it a try for free during the Steam Summer Festival! 
Make sure you download the demo and play what we've been working these last 2 years.

[h2]What's in the demo, you say?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Full Deathmatch experience, in 1 or 2 players mode.
[*] 1 Random Event: Haunted Seas
[*] Penalties Party mode, in 1 or 2 players mode.
[*] Training mode.
[/list]

[h2]Don't forget to wishlist Duel on Board on Steam![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/612040/Duel_on_Board/
